What this app does
Please read and confirm each item before continuing.
Network monitoring

A local VPN is created on this device. All network traffic passes through it so the app can show which apps talk to whom. Nothing is ever sent to the makers of PrivacyGuard.

â¢ The Exodus tracker list, at most once a week: reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org.
